name: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:...:accesspoint/*/object/* (every object via every access point) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 3 regression: isBroadArnResource() previously judged broadness from the resource-id HEAD alone (head = resourceId.split('/')[0]) and only tested a LEADING wildcard on that head. For a resource-TYPE-prefixed ARN the head is a CONCRETE type keyword ('accesspoint') and the wildcard lives in the IDENTIFIER segment after it, so accesspoint/*/object/* returned isBroadArnResource=false -> resourceIsBroad=false -> DATA-EXFIL treated the bulk read as scoped/routine -> analyze() ok:true findings=[] and CLI exit 0 CLEAN. An S3 access-point object grant of accesspoint/*/object/* reaches EVERY object via EVERY access point in the account - just as account-wide as arn:aws:s3:::*/*, which the corpus already locks. FAIL CLOSED: a leading-wildcard identifier right after a concrete resource-type head is broad. GetObject is a read verb, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE must NOT fire.
